Based on the provided context, several passages mention Khartoum as the capital of a nation referred to as the "largest African country" or "largest African nation." However, other passages explicitly state that Sudan is the "third largest country in Africa" and that after splitting in 2011, Sudan was "once the largest" but no longer holds that title. The text contains contradictory information regarding the current status of Sudan as the largest African nation versus it being the third largest.

Despite the factual inaccuracy in the premise (Sudan is no longer the largest), the text repeatedly associates Khartoum with the description of the "largest African nation" in the context of the country named **Sudan**. Specifically:
- "[DOC] [TLE] Khartoum country, 5 letter... Largest African nation. Largest country in Africa."
- "[DOC] [TLE] Khartoum City - Embassy of the Republic of Sudan... the largest African country."

The question asks for the nation whose capital is Khartoum and which is described in the text as the largest African nation.

<answer>Sudan</answer>
